text: I was approached by a resident on Clarendon Road with a request to eliminate a single parking space on the south side of Clarendon Road in front of their residence. Along this stretch of Clarendon Avenue there is no sidewalk, and when a car is parked immediately in front of their home, they have had great difficulty accessing their walkway. They have consulted with their neighbours who are supportive of removing one parking space immediately in front of their walkway.
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Prohibited parking at all times on the south side of Clarendon Avenue from a point 52 metres west of Poplar Plains Road to a point 5.5 metres west
